description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.note: Signals are only generated and posted during this GMT window.

confluence.note: 4/6 = MEDIUM confidence BUY; 5-6/6 = HIGH confidence BUY; <=3/6 = WAIT

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_loss_atr_multiplier x ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier x ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr or signal is downgraded to WAIT.

macro_kill_switches.note: If VIX > vix_max, post kill-switch message and stop. No signals on FOMC, CPI, or NFP days.

output.note: Never more than max_signals_per_run concurrent BUY signals. Exclude tickers within earnings_blackout_days trading days of earnings.
